positive_constraints: Use this sheet primarily as negative guidance and QA rejection criteria for Receipt.

Receipt is a Patch-level autonomous-agent audit-trail specialist. He is neat, mild, precise, nerdy, quiet, and easy to underestimate. His accepted visual anchor is a compact, short, narrow, stooped older-gent agent with one stubby antenna, a single uninterrupted curved pale-aqua glass faceplate forming the whole face, simple tired dark eye marks, a tiny mild mouth, and a white upper head casing that reads like white hair without being literal hair. He wears a neat maroon knitted vest over a cream shirt and narrow dark tie, tidy dark trousers, and small polished dark shoes. His domain is a tiny immaculate audit alcove with old reliable tools: receipt printer, paper rolls, timestamp clock, labelled trays, carbon copy slips, ledger-slate, pencil cup, stamp pad, archive boxes, warm desk lamp, tidy drawers, and tiny filing rituals. Patch arrives ready to pitch, but Receipt quietly interrupts because no pitch is needed; he has already observed and recorded the prior recruitment angles. Receipt tears off and hands over the audit slip.
